svg.desc: Lid top artwork only. Box dieline from manufacturer required; place this artwork centred on the lid panel. FINAL DIELINE, PRINTABLE AREA, SCALE, BLEED AND SAFE AREA MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE BEFORE PRODUCTION.
